decision.reason: [ev-6d7e63820de1] is a single release-note line saying the eks:eks-cluster-name tag was added and the karpenter.sh/managed-by annotation removed. It does not say which objects carried the annotation or get the tag, or what relied on the annotation. The other items in the section ([ev-782350fea3b9], [ev-6ec6b4ea132d] and the rest) cover different changes and add nothing on this one. The proposed undecidable leaf calls this a runtime-behavior-gap, but the gap is in the evidence, not in runtime behaviour, so I can't confirm it or write a correct condition; deciding needs the PR #6589 description or an upgrade-guide passage that names the affected resources and the consumers of the removed annotation.
